title: Build: Move prettier to oxfmt
body:

<!--

Thank you for contributing to Storybook! Please submit all PRs to the `next` branch unless they are specific to the current release. For additional guidance: https://storybook.js.org/docs/contribute

## What I did

This PR migrate prettier to oxfmt for perf improvements. Tried to keep most of our former rules to avoid having a gigantic PR.

~~@kasperpeulen should we also migrate codemods ? This maybe better to migrate later as everyone's not on oxfmt yet. If so I can revert the commit.~~ 
Same for scripts/tools ? 

ℹ️ oxfmt also format mdx. This is an opportunity to re-enable mdx formatting in docs in another PR. 

❓ should we also remove old prettier rules in a future PR to stick closer to oxlint rules from now on ?

🌐 Web query:

`oxfmt CLI default behavior --check flag formatter`

💡 Result:

- **Default behavior (no flags):** `oxfmt` **formats and writes files in place** (`--write` is the default) and, if you don’t pass any `PATH`, it formats the **current working directory** (equivalent to `prettier --write .`). [1][2]  
- **`--check`:** runs in **check mode**—it **does not write changes**; it **checks whether files are already formatted** (and “also show statistics”). [1][2]  
- **Related:** `--list-different` prints only the files that *would* change. [1][2]

**Sources:**  
[1] Oxc docs — Oxfmt CLI reference: `--write` default; `--check`; default `PATH` behavior. ([oxc.rs](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter/cli.html))  
[2] Oxc docs — Oxfmt Quickstart: “Running `oxfmt` without arguments formats the current directory … `prettier --write .`”; “Check formatting without writing files”. ([oxc.rs](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter/quickstart))

Citations:

**Add the missing `lint:other` script and ensure validation scripts use `--check` mode.**

`oxfmt` writes files in place by default, so `lint` becomes a mutation command instead of a validation gate. Additionally, `scripts/ci/common-jobs.ts` Line 202 calls `yarn lint:other`, but this script is not defined in `code/package.json`, causing CI to fail with "Unknown script" error.

Keep `lint` and `lint:other` as check-only validators using `oxfmt --check`, while leaving write-mode formatting to pre-commit hooks via `lint-staged`. ([oxc.rs](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/formatter/cli.html))

<details>
<summary>💡 Minimal fix</summary>

```diff
-    "lint": "yarn lint:js && yarn lint:fmt",
+    "lint": "yarn lint:js && yarn lint:fmt --check",
     "lint:ejs": "ejslint **/*.ejs",
     "lint:fmt": "oxfmt",
+    "lint:other": "yarn lint:fmt --check",
```
</details>

**Move mock behavior setup into `beforeEach` instead of module scope.**

Line 10 sets `mockImplementation` at module scope, which violates the repository's Vitest mock lifecycle rule and can cause behavior to persist across tests. Mock behaviors must be configured in `beforeEach` blocks.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
 
 import { dedent } from 'ts-dedent';
 
 import { formatFileContent } from 'storybook/internal/common';
 
 import { configToCsfFactory } from './config-to-csf-factory';
 
 vi.mock('storybook/internal/common', { spy: true });
-vi.mocked(formatFileContent).mockImplementation(async (_path, content) => content);
+
+beforeEach(() => {
+  vi.mocked(formatFileContent).mockImplementation(async (_path, content) => content);
+});
```
</details>

<!-- suggestion_start -->

vi.mocked(formatFileContent).mockImplementation(async (_path, content) =>
